Happy Birthday to Me — Roses & Cake

👇 This prompt makes a photo like this:

Create a birthday poster using my uploaded photo: keep my face and pose exactly the same, place me against a soft pink party background with warm fairy lights and pink roses, pink hearts floating beside me, a bouquet of red roses with white baby’s breath flowers at the bottom left, and a pink drip birthday cake with 5 lit pink-striped candles at the bottom right with “Happy Birthday to Me” written on the cake. Add elegant dark-pink script “Happy Birthday” at the top right, “to me...” under it, and the handwritten line “Another year of life, more dreams, more happiness and more love...”. Bright, sweet and celebratory. Portrait 2:3.

✨ Photo Enhance & Restore — Make Any Photo HD

Upload your photo, paste a prompt — blurry becomes sharp, old becomes new. The most searched prompts right now 👇

HD Quality Enhance — Make Photo Crystal Clear

👇 This prompt makes a photo like this:

Enhance my uploaded photo to ultra HD quality: sharpen all details, remove noise and grain, fix the lighting and colors naturally, and make my face crystal clear. Keep my face, clothes and background exactly the same — do not change anything else. Photorealistic, 8K quality.

Unblur — Fix a Blurry Photo

👇 This prompt makes a photo like this:

Fix my blurry uploaded photo: remove all blur and camera shake, restore sharp details on my face, hair and clothes, and correct the focus like it was taken with a DSLR camera. Keep everything else exactly the same. Natural and realistic.

Old Photo Restore — Make Old Photos New

👇 This prompt makes a photo like this:

Restore my old damaged photo: remove scratches, spots, folds and stains, repair faded and torn parts, sharpen the faces and details, and make it look like a fresh clean photo. Keep the same people, poses and background — do not change the faces.

Colorize — Black & White to Color

👇 This prompt makes a photo like this:

Colorize my black and white photo with natural, realistic colors: true-to-life skin tones, clothes and background, clean and sharp like a modern photo. Keep the faces, poses and everything else exactly the same.
